patch_description:
This change improves handling of scan and uniform-distribution workloads by:
1. Adding sequential scan detection (detect when folios are accessed in index order)
2. Implementing access-count decay (age older accesses so recent patterns matter more)
3. Refining burst detection with smoothing to reduce noise
4. Lowering congestion thresholds to catch network issues earlier
5. Making hot-folio protection less aggressive during marginal congestion

The key insight: scan workloads re-visit folios in sequence but each scan is independent. Detecting sequential patterns lets us evict scan folios more aggressively. Also, an access_count of 10 from 5 seconds ago should matter less than an access_count of 3 from 100ms ago.
